abilities.effect: The triggering creature falls 30 feet into area H7, taking 15 falling damage and an additional 6d6 piercing damage (DC 24 basic Reflex save) from the many stalagmites they land on. That creature can use the Grab an Edge reaction to avoid falling (DC 24).

abilities.trigger: A creature walks onto the sheet of fungus
